changes.summary: the context gains page + reportPage; the provider's state lives in the sibling hook (I2).
reports the viewport's current page into the shared context on every change.
passes the context page to usePresence instead of a hardcoded 0.
the phase predicate is current.sync.phase !== previous.sync.phase, so manualOfflineSet and networkDownSet drive the cycle.
pageImageData rasterizes one page off-screen to RGBA (null without a 2D context).
per page: rung 1; if a page has no annotations, rasterize and run rung 2.

decisions: The page mirror goes through the shared context, not a cross-feature import (I3) or an app-route store read (I4).
The listener watches the phase value, not the action type.
Rung 1 short-circuits the raster; rungs 1/2 never OCR.
